coverage_assessment: Twenty English/Arabic open-web searches covered weekly January windows, local and official outlets, regional/sector terms and Dec/Feb boundaries. No January onset candidate was identified in accessible material. Search results often surfaced later May 2021 actions and labor-administration records, not public gatherings. Arabic archive review is incomplete; several source pages failed cache/DNS access, an archive PDF timed out, and two result captures were truncated. This is not an absence or exhaustiveness claim.
